[SWS_UCM_00075]
In addition,
OTA Client
could support the ability to pause or resume the package
transfer for the current campaign to prioritize the transfer of the packages from a dif-
ferent campaign. The ability of
OTA Client
to pause or resume the package transfer
might be helpful in the case there is a need to cancel an ongoing campaign at
kTrans-
ferring
state to allow higher priority campaign to be performed.
Only one
UCM Master
has to be used by
OTA Client
s per network domain. As
UCM
Master
is distributing
Software Packages
and coordinating
UCM
subordinates,
OTA
Client
s in the same network domain have to make sure there are no already on-going
campaigns when starting a new campaign with
TransferVehiclePackage
method
call by checking
UCM Master
's state with
TransferState
field, in order to avoid any
interference and guarantee success of an update campaign.
